name: Medical
audience: Physicians, nurses and allied health professionals
declaration: Inborn runs a language model on this device. Patient information you enter never leaves it: no cloud, no account, no server. The model is not a medical device and not a clinician: it can state wrong doses, wrong interactions and wrong findings with full confidence. Every draft is for a licensed professional to check against the source record and current guidance before any use in care. Keep direct identifiers out of prompts where your institution's rules require it. Client vaults, the audit log and signed exports document what happened on this device; they are not a certification under any health-privacy law and do not make this device an approved record system. If you publish AI-generated text on a matter of public interest in the EU, you must disclose that it is AI-generated (EU AI Act, Art. 50(4)).
